beta.title: Module in beta
beta.body: Features are still missing, others will change. I'm looking for testers: tell me what doesn't work and what you need.

script.title: Still a prototype
script.body: NetsuDraft is very incomplete and barely tested: a lot is missing or doesn't work yet. Tell me what you would need first.

chat.title: Not working yet
chat.body: NetsuPilot is still in development: it does nothing useful yet. Follow its progress on Discord.

voice.title: Not tested enough yet
voice.body: NetsuTalk works, but it has had very little real-world use. Let me know if anything behaves oddly.

transfer.title: Not tested on every version
transfer.body: NetsuBridge has only been tested on a few versions of Resolve, Premiere Pro and After Effects: depending on yours, the copy may work, work only in part, or not work at all. Tell me your version and what doesn't work.

host.offlineResolve: Open a project with footage in Resolve, then reload, or import videos from disk.
host.offlineAdobe: Open {{app}}, then the NetsuRush panel (Window ▸ Extensions), or import videos from disk.

error.coreUnreachable: NetsuRush's background service isn't responding. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the app.
error.diskFull: The disk is full. Free up some space, then try again.
error.notFound: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.permission: Access denied. The file may be read-only or open in another app.
error.busy: Another app is using the file. Close it, then try again.
error.timeout: No response in time. Try again.
error.internal: Internal NetsuRush error. The details are in Settings › System › Console.
